product_summary: Chennai-based partnership (est. 2008, GST 33AABFF9849F1ZC, IEC 0409042714, UDYAM-TN-02-0029931) manufacturing and trading industrial thermal equipment: diesel/oil/gas/wood/biomass/husk/coal/solid-fuel fired steam boilers (300–4500 kg/hr, Rs 3–10.5 lakh/piece), vertical steam boilers, package steam boilers, oil/coal/wood/solid-fuel fired thermic fluid heaters, MS boiler chimneys and self-supported chimneys (20–30 m), heavy oil burners, Ecoflam gas burners, Siemens LME21.330C2 burner sequence controllers, plus (per About Us only) water treatment plants and water treatment chemicals. comment: HS-код заявлен неверно (industry misclassification). Declared 842121/842139 (filters & filtering/purifying machinery) and 848110/848130 (pressure-reducing and check valves) do not correspond to the actual catalogue: the site sells no filters, no pressure-reducing valves and no check valves. Only 842121 has a weak textual link — 'Water Treatment Plant' is named in the About Us paragraph, but there is no product page, no model, no specification and no customs line for it, so it is 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. The real product line is boilers (8402), thermic fluid heaters (841950), burners and burner controls (8416) and steel chimneys (840290/7308). Per Rule 3 the company is NOT rejected on HS grounds — it stays in the base with the code corrected to the factual line; verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Trader signs: 'Manufacturer and Trader', 'Service Provider and Others', 'Wholesale Business', resells Ecoflam and Siemens branded components (841690) — mixed manufacturer/trader profile. Product lines entirely missing from the declaration: steam boilers, thermic fluid heaters, industrial burners, burner sequence controllers, boiler chimneys/chimney fabrication services. Industry claim 'Нефтегаз и химия' is only partially supported: the site positions boilers for chemical, pharma, dairy, food-processing, textile and laundry users; no oil & gas (upstream/refinery) equipment, no flame arrestors, no pipeline valves are offered. Note: the company name 'Flamemax' may suggest flame-arrestor equipment, but no such product appears in the catalogue — do not assume 842139/848130 on that basis. No customs/export line was available to corroborate any code, so all HS assignments above are catalogue-based and remain 'заявлено, не подтверждено' until a shipment record is seen. Sources: https://www.flamemaxengineering.com/ (IndiaMART storefront, product list), https://www.flamemaxengineering.com/steam-boilers.html, https://www.flamemaxengineering.com/about-us.html. No registry, revenue or customs-volume data researched per role scope.
